zh: 工业化的重要变化，不是某一台机器突然出现，而是能源、动力、生产、资本和市场开始相互强化。单独拥有其中一项能力，并不足以形成能够持续扩大的工业生产。
煤提供了不同于主要依赖地表生长的能源条件，蒸汽技术把热能转为可控制的动力。机器又使某些动作能够反复执行。它们的作用需要放在燃料供应、技术维护与组织之中理解。
设备和生产规模扩大，需要资金、原料和可以吸收产品的市场。产量增加也会提出新的运输与管理要求。能力的增长不是消除所有限制，而是把限制移到新的关系与设施上。
因此，工业阈值不能只用效率提高概括。它改变人怎样安排劳动、城市怎样聚集、资本怎样投入，以及社会依赖哪些能源和网络。不同地方跨越这一阈值的组合和代价，仍然可能不同。
en: Industrialization was not the sudden appearance of one machine. Energy, power, production, capital and markets began to reinforce one another. Possessing any one of these capabilities alone was insufficient for sustained industrial expansion.

Coal offered energy conditions different from those relying primarily on surface growth, while steam technology converted heat into controllable power. Machines made certain actions repeatable. Their effects depended on fuel supplies, maintenance, skills and organization.

Larger equipment and output required finance, materials and markets able to absorb products. Greater production also created demands for transport and management. Growing capability did not remove every limit; it relocated limits into new relationships and infrastructure.

The industrial threshold therefore cannot be reduced to higher efficiency. It changed work, urban concentration, investment and dependence on energy and networks. The combinations and costs through which different places crossed that threshold could still differ.

zh: 机器不会自动产生工厂。动力、设备、原料、劳动与管理需要在同一地点持续协调，才使集中生产成为一种组织方式。工厂改变的不只是生产地点，也是人们共同使用时间的方法。
家庭和作坊可以有不同节律，集中生产却要求开工、轮班、纪律与产量互相配合。劳动时间因此进入更精细的安排。效率提高与劳动关系的改变，属于同一过程。
工业城市把人口、生产和污染集中起来，铁路又把越来越远的地方接入往返。运输更快以后，协调需要共同时间；电报让信息比人员和商品更快移动，改变了远距离决策的条件。
这些设施不能只当作独立发明罗列。它们共同改变社会的节奏、距离与依赖。某个节点停顿，可能影响更大范围；新能力也因此要求新的维护、规则与责任。
en: Machines do not automatically create factories. Power, equipment, materials, labor and management must be coordinated continuously in one place. The factory changes not only where production occurs but how people organize shared time.

Households and workshops could follow different rhythms. Concentrated production required starting times, shifts, discipline and output to fit together. Labor time became more precisely arranged. Efficiency and changing labor relations belonged to the same process.

Industrial cities concentrated population, production and pollution, while railways connected increasingly distant places. Faster transport required shared time. Telegraphy moved information ahead of people and goods, changing the conditions for distant decisions.

These facilities should not be listed merely as separate inventions. Together they changed rhythm, distance and dependence. An interruption at one node could affect a wider area, making new maintenance, rules and responsibilities necessary.

zh: 工业时代的知识变化，不只是发现更多事实，也是形成能够持续培养研究者的组织。学会、期刊、大学、实验室与工程机构，让方法与记录有机会跨越个人生命继续积累。
大众教育扩大了进入共同知识和纪律的范围，资本则支持机器、铁路和工厂等长期投入。知识、劳动与资金彼此联系，不能把工业发展单独解释为某个天才或某笔财富的结果。
但这些能力进入各地时，并不具有相同的制度关系。国家、银行、企业、土地与劳动的安排，会影响资源怎样组织、收益怎样分配，以及哪些成本由谁承担。
所以，科学、教育与资本的传播没有消除工业文明的差异。相似工具可以进入不同历史结构，形成不同组合。共同跨越能源和生产阈值，并不意味着所有社会获得同一份制度答案。
en: Industrial-era knowledge changed through more than additional discoveries. Organizations could continually train researchers. Societies, journals, universities, laboratories and engineering institutions allowed methods and records to accumulate beyond individual lives.

Mass education widened access to shared knowledge and discipline, while capital supported long-term investment in machines, railways and factories. Knowledge, work and finance were connected; industrial development cannot be explained solely through a genius or a fortune.

These capabilities did not enter identical institutional relationships everywhere. Arrangements among states, banks, firms, land and labor shaped how resources were organized, returns distributed and costs borne.

The spread of science, education and capital therefore did not erase industrial differences. Similar tools entered different historical structures and formed different combinations. Crossing related energy and production thresholds did not provide every society with one institutional answer.

zh: 现代国家的变化，不在于历史上第一次出现强大政府，而在于国家与社会之间的距离发生改变。登记、教育、行政和共同规则，使国家越来越直接地面对辖区内的人口。
民族主义把语言、历史和政治归属组织成群众身份。学校、记录和公共叙述帮助陌生人想象共同体，同时也提出谁被算作成员、谁被排除的问题。共同身份并不是没有边界的。
官僚组织依靠职位、档案和专业知识持续运作，工业技术则扩大交通、军事与资源调动能力。这些能力既可能用于国家内部建设，也可能被用于控制远方。
民族国家与帝国因此并非简单前后替代。工业时代可以同时扩大公民政治与海外支配。理解现代能力，需要继续追问它被谁掌握、用于何处，而不能从制度的名称直接推断结果。
en: The modern state did not mark the first appearance of powerful government. It changed the distance between government and society. Registration, education, administration and common rules brought states into more direct relationships with their populations.

Nationalism organized language, history and political belonging into mass identities. Schools, records and public narratives helped strangers imagine a shared community while defining who belonged and who was excluded. Common identity was not without boundaries.

Bureaucracy sustained activity through offices, archives and expertise, while industrial technology expanded transport, military and resource-mobilizing capabilities. These could support domestic construction or control over distant places.

Nation-states and empires therefore did not simply replace one another in sequence. The industrial era could expand civic politics alongside overseas domination. Understanding modern capabilities requires asking who controlled them and how they were used, rather than deriving outcomes from institutional names.

zh: 明治转型之前的日本不是一张空白纸。已有的商业、城市、教育与地方行政，为后来学习和重新组织能力提供了基础。改革速度需要放在这些积累中理解，不能只用外来刺激解释。
晚清、奥斯曼与俄罗斯也各自面对已有制度和外部压力。它们需要调整财政、军事和治理，却不能简单删除原有社会。改革改变一些关系，同时也会受到其他关系的限制。
如果多个领域必须同时改变，资源和时间就会相互竞争。某项新制度在一个地方能够运作，不意味着以同样速度移入另一处便会产生同样结果。能力的吸收也有条件。
比较改革因此不是寻找一个可以复制的成功配方，而是理解不同社会怎样重新组合过去与外来能力。历史积累并未因现代化而消失；它继续影响哪些改变可行，以及改变要承担什么代价。
en: Japan before the Meiji transformation was not a blank sheet. Existing commerce, cities, education and local administration supported later learning and reorganization. The speed of reform needs to be understood through those accumulations, not external pressure alone.

Late Qing China, the Ottoman Empire and Russia each confronted inherited institutions and external pressures. They needed to alter finance, military organization and government without simply deleting their existing societies. Reforms changed some relationships while being constrained by others.

When many fields must change together, resources and time compete. An institution working in one place does not guarantee the same result when imported elsewhere at the same speed. Absorbing capabilities has its own conditions.

Comparing reform is therefore not a search for a reproducible success formula. It asks how societies recombined inherited structures and outside capabilities. Historical accumulation remained active within modernization, shaping feasible changes and their costs.

zh: 现代设施与政治自主不是同一件事。殖民地可以拥有铁路、法院、学校和行政记录，却不一定能够决定这些制度服务于谁。相似的外形，可能包含很不相同的权力关系。
印度的殖民现代性，正要求我们把能力与控制权分开。现代制度进入社会，不意味着控制制度的人与使用它的人处在平等位置。运输和教育的存在，不能独自证明自主发展的条件已经成立。
拉丁美洲独立之后，政治主权也没有自动抹去土地、出口和社会关系的历史。非洲进入殖民体系时，各地此前的社会结构与联系同样不同，不能被视为经历相同过程的一块整体。
因此，现代化并没有共同起点。独立国家、改革帝国与殖民社会，会以不同方式接入全球体系。比较时需要说明谁决定制度方向、谁取得收益、谁承担成本，而不是只清点现代设施是否存在。
en: Modern facilities and political autonomy are different things. A colony could possess railways, courts, schools and administrative records without deciding whose purposes they served. Similar forms could contain very different relations of power.

Colonial modernity in India requires precisely this distinction between capability and control. The arrival of modern institutions did not place those controlling and using them in equal positions. Transport and education alone did not establish conditions for autonomous development.

Latin American independence likewise did not automatically erase histories of land, exports and social relationships. African societies entering colonial arrangements also possessed different prior structures and connections; they were not one uniform space undergoing an identical process.

Modernization therefore had no common starting point. Independent states, reforming empires and colonial societies entered global systems differently. Comparison must ask who directed institutions, received benefits and bore costs, rather than merely count modern facilities.

zh: 铁路、学校、工厂、银行和现代政府越来越普遍以后，世界看起来开始使用相似工具。但工具相似，并没有使国家、资本与社会之间的关系变得相同。现代化没有结束分化，而是改变了差异所在的层次。
不同社会需要把新能力接进自己的历史。土地、阶级、宗教、语言和殖民经验不会因为出现新制度就消失。过去既可能提供资源，也可能形成限制，影响改革怎样展开。
关键问题转向谁控制国家、谁拥有资本、谁能够参与政治，以及谁承担发展和帝国的成本。现代能力可以进入不同权力结构，不能仅凭工厂、铁路和学校的存在便认定共同结果。
因此，现代性更像一组不断扩散和重新组合的能力，而不是所有社会必须抵达的唯一目的地。理解它，需要追踪相似压力如何产生不同道路。第五册在这里把问题带向下一册：这些不同的现代社会相遇后，世界将怎样再次重组。
en: As railways, schools, factories, banks and modern governments became more widespread, societies appeared to use similar tools. Yet relationships among states, capital and society did not become identical. Modernization did not end divergence; it changed the level at which differences were organized.

Societies had to connect new capabilities to their own histories. Land, class, religion, language and colonial experience did not vanish when new institutions appeared. Inherited conditions could provide resources or impose limits, shaping how reform unfolded.

The central questions became who controlled the state, owned capital, participated in politics and bore the costs of development and empire. Modern capabilities could serve different power structures. Factories, railways and schools alone did not establish a common outcome.

Modernity is therefore better understood as capabilities that spread and recombine than as one destination every society must reach. Similar pressures could generate different paths. Volume V carries this question toward the next volume: how would the encounter among these different modern societies reorganize the world again?
